meta.name: prisma-postgres-setup
meta.description: Obtain or reuse a Prisma Postgres database and connect an application. Use for "set up Prisma Postgres", "connect my app to Prisma Postgres", or Prisma Postgres setup in v0 and Vercel Marketplace. Hands Prisma ORM configuration to prisma-orm-setup; honors an explicit driver, alternative ORM, or database-only choice.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拿到一个 Prisma Postgres 数据库并把应用连上去,完成连接配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用加一个 Postgres 数据库却不想自己搭服务器
copy.tagline_en: Get a Prisma Postgres database and wire your app up to it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a Postgres database for your app without running your own server

howto.what: 它会检查你的项目，复用已有的或新建一个 Prisma Postgres 数据库，把连接信息存进项目的密钥环境配置（不写进代码或聊天），再跑一次只读查询确认连得上。ORM 配置交给 prisma-orm-setup 处理。
howto.when: 当你提到「set up Prisma Postgres」等说法，或要在 v0、Vercel Marketplace 里配置 Prisma Postgres 时触发。已配置好的应用里做查询或改 schema 不会重新走一遍配置。

say.text: 帮我把应用连到 Prisma Postgres
say.note: 先检查项目，再复用或新建数据库

say.text: 建一个临时的开发用 Prisma Postgres 数据库

say.text: 只配 Prisma Postgres 数据库，不配 ORM

howto.what_en: It inspects your project, reuses or provisions a Prisma Postgres database, saves the connection in secret env config (not code or chat), then verifies connectivity with a read-only query. ORM setup goes to prisma-orm-setup.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "set up Prisma Postgres" or the like, or configure Prisma Postgres in v0 or the Vercel Marketplace. Query or schema work in a configured app does not retrigger it.

say_en.text: Connect my app to Prisma Postgres
say_en.note: Checks the project first, then reuses or provisions a database
